fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UsedTruck/VehicleReport.cy.js#UsedTruck - VehicleReport [en] — Vehicle Report TC-VHR-02: Contact Seller lead submits successfully on Vehicle Report
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-VHR-02
**Title:** Contact Seller lead submits successfully on Vehicle Report
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Vehicle Report page, open the shared Check Offers lead form via Contact Seller, fill name, mobile and city, and submit.

**Expected Result:**
A Thank You confirmation is shown after a successful lead submission. The submitted name is tagged with a page/CTA identifier for CRM traceability.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Vehicle Report page
2. Open the Contact Seller lead form
3. Fill name, mobile and city
4. Submit and verify Thank You confirmation
